packages.publisherCheck: GitHub release asset digest equals the local SHA-256 of the installer; the rule is trust publisher + signature true, so every download must also pass Authenticode Valid (the orca model)

rejectedPayload.reason: built with 7z a -tzip -m0=LZMA: 206 entries use ZIP method 14 (LZMA). It passes the source-side checkLayout because 7-Zip lists it, but client 0.4.36 decodes ZIP through yauzl, which accepts only Stored and Deflate; the isolated install failed with 'unsupported compression method: 14'

packages.stripPrefix: none; explicit 208-entry files map over the {app} tree

layout.listedEntries: 210: 209 under {app} plus the innounp-generated install_script.iss, which is not mapped
layout.duplicateEntries: Inno 6.7.0 lists the main program twice ({app}\Ghost-Downloader-3,1.exe and ,2.exe) because the upstream iss names it in an explicit Source line and again through the dist/* wildcard. Each is 64471896 bytes with sha256 f70f3ebdf05eaabcba13a8119fba72ef744634adace7d6ca185b04334f5c88e0, equal to Ghost-Downloader-3.exe in the official ZIP
layout.filesMap: "Ghost-Downloader-3,1.exe": "Ghost-Downloader-3.exe"; the ,2 duplicate is left unmapped; the other 207 entries map one-to-one
layout.equalsOfficialZipTree: 208/208 files byte-identical to the official Windows x86_64 ZIP

commandModel.ghd: upstream CLI launcher: resolves Ghost-Downloader-3.exe two levels above its own module path and forwards argv over the local socket GhostDownloader-<user>; starts the main program in the background when no instance is running
commandModel.desktop: Ghost Downloader shortcut declared; requires separate integrate --desktop preview/confirmation

stateModel.portableMode: upstream switches to a program-side GhostDownloader folder only when that directory already exists next to the executable; neither official distribution ships it

isolatedInstall.pikoHome: temporary directory with a local HTTP source copy
isolatedInstall.zipAttempt: piko install iso/ghost-downloader@4.5.11 with the ZIP recipe failed: unsupported compression method: 14
isolatedInstall.innoAttempt: piko install iso/ghost-downloader@4.5.11 with the Inno recipe installed; the client fetched its own pinned innounp helper
isolatedInstall.installedTreeVsOfficialZip: 208/208 files byte-identical; the only extra file is the .piko-install.json receipt
isolatedInstall.ruleAfterInstall: the install ran while the rule was trust https; the rule was then tightened to trust publisher + signature true (recipe, files map and version row unchanged). Exact-version installs do not read the upstream rule; after the change the client still refreshed, searched and listed the final catalog
